mapper.select: SELECT t1.`digital_id`, t1.`event_name`, t1.`event_grade_dict`, t1.`event_type_large_category`, t1.`event_type_middle_category`, t1.`event_type_small_category`, t1.`event_describe`, t1.`remark`, t1.`tenant_id`, t1.`industry_code`, t1.`app_ver_code`,t1.commander,t3.nick_name commanderName, t1.`create_time`, t1.`creator`, t1.`delete_flag`, t1.`death_count`, t1.`emergency_count`, t1.`collapses_count`, t1.`difficult_count`, t1.`other`, t1.`accept_node`, t2.origin_url,t2.file_id,t2.file_suffix,t2.file_name,t2.file_size FROM vm_digital_info t1 LEFT JOIN vm_emergency_attach t2 ON t1.digital_id = t2.business_code LEFT JOIN sys_user t3 ON t1.commander = t3.user_id AND t3.DEL_FLAG = 0 WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.digital_id = #{digitalId}

LEFT JOIN sys_user t3 ON t1.creator = t3.user_name AND t3.DEL_FLAG = 0

select t2.`stage_id`, t2.`digital_id`, t2.`plan_id`, t2.`sort`, t2.`stage_name`, t2.`stage_days`, t2.`stage_target` FROM vm_digital_stage t2 where t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.digital_id = #{digitalId} ORDER BY t2.sort ASC

SELECT t3.`task_id`, t3.`digital_id`, t3.`plan_id`, t3.`stage_id`, t3.task_name, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t3.task_name, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(t3.task_name) ELSE SUBSTRING(t3.task_name, 1, 1) END AS sortName, t3.`content`, t3.`user_ids`,t4.id, t4.resource_id FROM vm_digital_task t3 LEFT JOIN vm_emergency_resource_info t4 ON t3.task_id = t4.task_id AND t4.delete_flag = 0 WHERE t3.delete_flag = 0 AND t3.stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY IF(SUBSTRING(t3.task_name, 1, 1) RLIKE '^[a-z]', 1, 2), CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(t3.task_name, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(t3.task_name) ELSE SUBSTRING(t3.task_name, 1, 1) END

select stage_id as digitalStageId, digital_id as digitalId, stage_name, stage_days as stageDays, stage_target as stageDetail from vm_digital_stage where digital_id = #{digitalId} and delete_flag = '0' order by sort

select plan_id as targetId, digital_id as digitalId, target_days as targetDays, stage_count as stageNum, total_target as globalDetail from vm_digital_plan where digital_id = #{digitalId} and delete_flag = '0'

select task_id as digitalTaskId, digital_id as digitalId, stage_id as digitalStageId, content as taskDetail, user_ids, task_name from vm_digital_task where digital_id = #{digitalId} and delete_flag = '0'
select * from vm_emergency_resource_info where event_code = #{digitalId} and delete_flag = '0'

SELECT t1.`plan_id`, t1.`digital_id`, t1.`target_days`, t1.`stage_count`, t1.`total_target`, t1.`creator`, t1.`create_time`, t1.`delete_flag`, t1.`tenant_id`, t1.`industry_code`,t2.`stage_id`, t2.`digital_id`, t2.`plan_id`, t2.`sort`, t2.`stage_name`, t2.`stage_days`, t2.`stage_target`, t3.`task_id`, t3.task_name,t3.`digital_id`, t3.`plan_id`, t3.`stage_id`, t3.`content`, t3.`user_ids`,t4.id, t4.resource_id FROM vm_digital_plan t1 LEFT JOIN vm_digital_stage t2 ON t1.plan_id = t2.plan_id LEFT JOIN vm_digital_task t3 ON t2.stage_id = t3.stage_id LEFT JOIN vm_emergency_resource_info t4 ON t2.stage_id = t4.stage_id AND t3.task_id = t4.task_id WHERE t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.digital_id = #{digitalId}
